mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5% or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration that triggers Fed rate-cut expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate monetary stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1.0% MoM or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate increases above 2.0% signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% during tightening cycles or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and CPI declines indicate dovish policy response to disinflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as rate-cut expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansions, industrial production exceeding 108.0 signals strengthening manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when INDPRO > 108.0 during early-cycle expansions or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1250.0 indicate robust consumer demand and confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through stronger retail and construction sector performance.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of observations when HOUST > 1250.0 or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.
